newsitem.title: UK: UK govt announces road-building review.
newsitem.headline: UK govt announces road-building review.

text.p: The British government announced on Thursday it was launching a review of the road-building programme which it hoped would report its conclusions next spring.
Transport Minister Gavin Strang said in a statement that some major new schemes would be halted until the review was complete.
"Schemes on which construction is already well advanced will continue, but preparatory work on new major schemes will be put on hold at the end of the current stage," he said.

"There are also 12 cases on which urgent decisions are pending. We therefore propose to carry out an accelerated review of these cases against the criteria of accessibility, safety, economy and environmental impact and announce our decisions on them in July," Strang said.
The review would consider environmental questions and consider government plans for an integrated transport policy.
